`legacy_marks.xls` is a synthetic BIFF8 workbook generated locally with xlwt 1.3.0 solely for testing the xlrd reader. It contains two students (Asha: Math 82, Science 90; Mira: Math 71, Science 85), native Excel dates (2026-01-01 and 2026-02-01), and an empty second worksheet. It contains no macros, formulas, or real personal data. The committed fixture means xlwt is not needed to run the application or tests.
